bucket_probability_derivation: Arithmetic mean of each role's episode-count proportions. Fixed equal role counts within a chosen bucket; uniform episodes within each role/bucket. Three initial shape-validation updates visit 128/256/384 in both arms, then declared probabilities. No truncated histories.
next_gate: Passing this one-seed component screen permits real native rollout/latency and independent KataGo evaluation, not production promotion. Record wall time, valid/padded exposure, failures and all checkpoints. Baseline first eight updates qualify full-size memory and shared checkpoint materialization before continuing its unchanged frozen run.

primary_component_screen.definition: Average expert and behavior (1-distribution_overlap), each averaged over its own full validation population. Compare final 1024-update endpoints. Same sampler trajectory and position exposures must be verified.

scope: One matched seed and 1024 AdamW updates per arm on existing weak-teacher data. Exact MCTS policy labels and observed behavior remain separate. Full held-out validation and final test populations. Teacher/previous data collection cost remains included in lineage. This tests a component; it is not online RL or a strength comparison with current KataGo.
